programs.description: Listen to a comprehensive compilation of some of the most melodious classic tunes one after the other in quick succession.

Tensions between two brothers arise when one of their daughters marries a government employee. Meanwhile, when Udas's first wife dies and his childhood sweetheart rejects him, he becomes an alcoholic.
